title: London Vegan Places
description: A community-maintained guide to vegan and vegan-friendly places to eat in London. Please check details directly with each venue before visiting.
verification_policy: Community guide only. Listings and details may change. All map positions are approximate; some entries are pop-ups, residencies, representative branches or community listings. Check each listing directly before travelling.
